data.action: 举着冰镇鸡尾酒杯小口品尝新配方
data.description: 【羽毛笔 · 特调品尝】吧台柔和的暖光下，拉菲艾拉端着盛满气泡碎冰的高脚玻璃杯，用吸管小口品尝着自己研发的新配方果味鸡尾酒。她满足地弯起嘴角，将吸管递到你的嘴边——「甜甜的……还有点果香。博士快尝一口，这是我最喜欢的新配方！」
data.lighting: warm twilight dusk light, soft amber glass reflections, cozy bar backlighting
data.promptProse: At dusk, La Pluma tastes her new fruit cocktail through a straw, holding the iced stemmed glass beside her satisfied smile. Her bartender apron and ribbon tie remain visible above the marble counter. Amber light behind the bar passes through the glass and catches the ice; twilight softens her cheek, while bottle rows recede behind her in this medium close-up.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 特调品尝
